Subject: Promotion write-up alignment + exec touchpoint scheduling (Q1 calibration)

Team —

Attached is v3 of Ryan Patel's promotion write-up. I consolidated feedback from the IC advocates but want a tight pass on: scope framing (is "platform reliability" too broad?), evidence bullets (need 2 measurable metrics not 3 qualitative points), and the proposed exec touchpoint narrative (15 min with CEO + HR ops to pre-brief the committee).

Can each of you: 1) add line edits in the doc (track changes off; just make inline edits), 2) flag any potential conflict-of-interest in the attached conflict matrix, and 3) confirm availability windows for a short exec touchpoint next week (Mon/Tue/Thu preferred).

I've also included a one-slide exec brief (exec-briefing-slides.pdf) we can use if we get the 15-min slot. HR partner (Emma) looped in below for scheduling and redaction guidance.

Attachments: draft_writeup_ryan_v3.docx (docx), conflict_matrix_Q1-2027.xlsx (xlsx), exec-briefing-slides.pdf (pdf)

Thanks —
Karthik
Sr. Dir, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Promotion write-up alignment + exec touchpoint scheduling (Q1 calibration)

Karthik —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a pass:
- Scope: "platform reliability" reads broad; suggest "platform reliability (availability & incident MTTR)" to keep the exec ask measurable.
- Evidence: replace the qualitative bullet about "led cross-team initiative" with two metrics: 
  * Reduced incident MTTR from 72m to 34m (Q1–Q3)
  * Improved availability of core RPCs from 99.87% to 99.95% (measured month-over-month)
- Tone: trim passive phrasing in the intro — make the impact explicit in first paragraph.

I made inline edits in draft_writeup_ryan_v3.docx and added comments where we might want legal redaction (customer names in the second evidence paragraph). Marcus — can you confirm the availability matrix?

SG,
Laura
Group Product Manager
Redwood Inference
